active_space.chemical_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25. CH2S + SH: CH2S pi/pi-star plus both SH p components. Source canonical 18,19,21,22, optimized natural 19-22. The alternate donor initialization converges to the same compact solutions at both endpoints in both bases. Two equally weighted doublets support the SH orbital pair. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote. Outer dividing surfaces use fragment COM separation; the correction scan uses the mapped interfragment anchor of the saved product complex. Preserve both explicitly configured grids and the product-side geometry.

HCS + H2S outer exit: retain CAS(3,3), HCS occupied pi/SOMO/pi-star natural 20-22, one doublet D1. The fixed control opening the actual H2S lone pair (source 19) changes the near energy by only 1.7e-7/1.5e-7 Eh (DZ/TZ), with no reported far change and added occupation 2.00000. Opening source 18 instead adds HCS correlation, not the H2S donor. The optimized occupied union expels the intended H2S direction and is not evidence for adding it. Both shift labels share the verified product endpoint but retain their own request identities. These are evidence-based chemical active-space choices. They do not certify quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular, relaxed-path or plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital/state/connectivity guards. Retain direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz CBS power 3.7, a separate 30 A asymptote, and the existing mapped correction coordinate and COM dividing surfaces. No existing production model is changed here.
